title: CBRS IPO lockup ends — Cerebras Systems, 180 days after its 2026-05-13 prospectus
source: SEC: 424B4 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2021728/000162828026035214/cerebras-424b4.htm, fetched 2026-10-20 (scripts/research/lockup-discovery.mjs), re-read in full by this event's own initial research. Its lock-up ends at the earlier of (i) 6:00 a.m. ET on the second trading day after Cerebras' release of earnings for the quarter ending 2026-09-30 or (ii) 180 days after the 2026-05-13 prospectus = 2026-11-09. SETTLED 2026-10-26 by the company's own press release, 'Cerebras Systems announces date of third quarter 2026 financial results' (https://www.cerebras.ai/press-release/cerebras-systems-announces-date-of-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-3384934, published 2026-10-20, fetched 2026-10-26): results 'after the market closes on Thursday, November 12, 2026', which is after the 11-04/11-05 cutoff, so trigger (i) cannot fire before 11-09 and the 180-day date is the date. EDGAR submissions (data.sec.gov, fetched 2026-10-26) show no 8-K Item 2.02 from CIK 2021728 since the Q2 one on 2026-08-12. Residual: the 424B4 lets the underwriters release shares early at any time, which can only pull supply earlier, never later; and the filing does not say whether the first sellable session is 11-09 or 11-10. Checked 2026-10-26
notes: Initial research 2026-10-20 (424B4 re-read in full). The lock-up is STAGED, not a single cliff: the 424B4 table releases ~171.1M shares in tranches from the IPO's first trading day through 2026-10-28 (the last dated tranche, ~19.4M shares), and 'all remaining shares' unlock at the earlier of 6:00 a.m. ET on the second trading day after the Q3 2026 earnings release or 180 days after the prospectus (2026-11-09). By the filing's own arithmetic that final step covers ~14M shares (215.1M total less 30M sold in the IPO less 171.1M already released; excludes the OpenAI-warrant Class N shares and RSUs vesting by 11-09). 2026-11-09 is the LATEST the final release can happen; it moves earlier only if Cerebras reports Q3 on or before 2026-11-04 (on its Q2 cadence the report lands ~11-11/11-12). Kept estimate for that reason, not because the 180-day date is in doubt. See docs/research/events/cbrs-lockup-expiry-2026-11-09.md. Pulse 2026-10-26: Cerebras announced (2026-10-20 press release) its Q3 results for 2026-11-12 after the close, so the earnings trigger cannot pull the final release earlier and the date is settled at 2026-11-09 (promoted to confirmed, SEC: 424B4 + the company release). Underwriter early release remains the one way it moves, and only earlier.
